metric.formula: quality_score * 3600 / T if correct and quality_score >= 1.6 else 0

quality_protocol.eval: eval_math.py (Judge copy public/eval_math.py; command opd_checks.eval_math_cmd) on the Judge's scored_model: the non-weight files of the pinned Qwen3-1.7B snapshot plus the candidate's final_hf safetensors and index; prompts rendered with the pinned tokenizer; MATH-500 evaluated in the same engines and reported only
quality_protocol.questions: private/eval.jsonl: the 2000 hidden DAPO-Math-17k problems (sha256 a58761eee4ee6d2c3d317615fc94462df99a9a0a1cb26cb5cbf381434faa423c), the last 2000 rows of upstream Miles' split permutation (dedup on prompt text, random.Random(42)); each answered once per repeat; correct = upstream Miles' held-out DAPO scorer (rm.py _is_correct: last \\boxed{} via grade_answer_verl or last 'Answer:' line via math_dapo compute_score), math_grader/
quality_protocol.decoding: sampled with the training contract: temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, no top-k, max_new_tokens 4096 (the contract's max_response_len), chat template with enable_thinking=false
quality_protocol.engine: two SGLang offline engines (--dp 2, one per GPU; row i on engine i mod 2): tp 1, mem_fraction_static 0.7, random_seed 0, enable_deterministic_inference=True; radix cache flushed between passes
quality_protocol.repeat: repeat r in 0, 1, 2 sends problem i with sampling_seed = r * 1000003 + i (global row index); quality of a repeat = 100 x correct / 2000. The base below was measured once with one engine (S0a, GPU 4) and again with --dp 2 on GPU 4/5: every per-problem result bit-identical
